encodings: *B64 = RFC 4648 §4 standard base64 WITH padding, canonical trailing bits; *Hex = lowercase hex; wire / *Json = exact UTF-8 text; randomness = the golden PRNG stream (README.md#prng) under the recorded label
notes: c = b64(0x01 ‖ kid ‖ eph_pub[32] ‖ box[25] ‖ csig[64]) (123 bytes, 164 characters), an outer key of a msg frame OUTSIDE the v2 binding; box = crypto_box(pt, nonce, courier_pub, eph_priv); pt = 0x01 ‖ BE64(to); nonce = SHA-256("mrenzo-courier-nonce-v1" ‖ eph_pub ‖ courier_pub)[0..24].

csig = Ed25519(ED_from, UTF-8("mrenzo-courier-v1|" + id + "|" + ts + "|" + from + "|" + kid + "|" + b64(SHA-256(inner blob bytes)) + "|" + b64(SHA-256(eph_pub ‖ box)))), verified strictly under the frame's own sig_pub. The builder draws the ephemeral secret (32 bytes).

EVERY node checks csig (no secret is needed): a capsule that does not verify is ABSENT — the frame stays valid, but the capsule is neither stored nor relayed (`relayKeeps`). So a bystander cannot put its own capsule in the place of the sender's.

Each negative: `frame` passes the strict frame check; `relayKeeps` = the check returns the capsule; `serverOpens` = opening it for key id `kid` with the private key `courierPrivB64` yields a recipient (never, in this list).

Server, per uploaded frame: strict frame check (meshV11.json, its own freshness window; this includes csig) → kind msg → kid known → open the box with the courier private key → to → sig_pub is the directory key of from → claim H(from|id) → route `routed` as if from had sent it.
A 1.0.0 node does not see c (it reads only the keys it knows); it verifies, delivers and ACKs the frame unchanged.

seenSet.note: One node, one seen set, in order (§W8.3). Each row is a copy heard on `lane` (a radio: a frame is relayed only on the radio it was heard on) with `canRelay` = that radio has somebody to pass the frame on to. `admit` is decided BEFORE any signature work from the peeked seen key, `hops` and capsule claim: new | duplicate (dropped, free) | upgrade (checked again). For an admitted frame: `first` = act on it (once per node, whatever the lane); `forward` = the exact frames to emit, each with its lane (empty = none); `capsuleUpgrade` = the first verified capsule for a frame seen without one. The set remembers, per frame, the hops THIS node relayed it with on each lane and — for the node as a whole — the verified capsule itself: an emission carries that capsule whether or not the copy in hand does, and a capsule upgrade is emitted on every lane the node relayed on, at the hops of that earlier emission, whatever the upgrading copy's hops or lane are. A row with `markOwn` records a frame the node transmits itself (its echo is a duplicate on every lane). A node emits one frame at most twice per lane, and only a copy that passed the whole check can cause any emission. `orderings`: each entry is a FRESH node — the two unsigned levers (hops, the capsule) used together in every order, and the two-radio cases; in each, the last emission on every lane carries the sender's capsule.
